actualGeometry.method: Actual retained base binary geometry and source OBJ conversion; nearest triangle distance is spatial evidence, not proof of vascular connectivity or anatomical identity.

identityAssessment.confirmedConceptSemantics: FMA8620 is pulmonary, with official path to right upper lobe and right lung.
identityAssessment.confirmedGeometryLocation: The two actual meshes occupy right renal arterial context, far below the source lung surfaces.
identityAssessment.inference: Likely legacy renal-branch geometry assigned to a pulmonary concept.
identityAssessment.unresolved: No retained official object-to-renal-concept mapping identifies the exact branch. FMA86342/86344 are distinct renal concepts; no FJ2041/FJ2044 mapping to them was found.

recommendedHandling.currentScope: Evidence only; no public/raw group edits.
recommendedHandling.followUp: Keep raw source mappings and FJ IDs. If cleaner navigation is desired, add an explicit source-anomaly note and a project-curated pulmonary selection excluding these two IDs; retain raw source group access and explain exclusions.
recommendedHandling.notAuthorizedOrRecommended: No silent deletion, shape movement, invented renal identity, or use of these objects as validated pulmonary supply geometry.
